response.sql:
SELECT AVG(avg_rental_duration) AS avg_of_rating_avg_rental_duration, AVG(avg_rate_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_rate_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
) AS per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating with at least one qualifying film receives equal weight in the final averages; SQL AVG ignores NULL ratios.
